notes.title: Major Update: New Cars & Game Modes!
notes.content:
[p]After a long break, we’re back... and not just with a small patch, but with the [b]biggest update yet[/b]![/p][p]The game has been reimagined and rebuilt from the ground up, bringing fresh content, new modes, and a smoother experience overall.[/p][p]
What’s New:[/p][list][*][p][b]Freeroam[/b] – freely explore brand-new maps at your own pace.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drift Mode[/b] – test your drifting skills and master car control.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drag Races[/b] – challenge your reaction time and precision in straight-line speed duels.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Racing[/b] – compete against opponents in thrilling high-speed competitions.[/p][/*][/list][p]And this is just the beginning! From now on, expect a steady flow of updates with:[/p][list][*][p]New maps[/p][/*][*][p]New cars[/p][/*][*][p]More game modes[/p][/*][*][p]Continuous improvements and optimizations[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you for your patience and suppor. We’re excited to bring this new chapter of the game to life. [/p][p]Get ready to hit the road![/p]

notes.title: Small Update v2.0
notes.content:
It's been a long time since I launched the game and I haven't made any updates. I'm aware of the bugs the game has and today I came with a small update of the game.

I made a small update to the game.
- I created a settings menu to have a pleasant gaming experience
- I changed the game map
- I added new maps 
- I added a small game mode (Racing) where you can race against the AI.
- I added new cars
I will continue to make updates in the future to give you the best gaming experience.
Thank you!
